title: Uncertainty-Aware LSTM + Market-Implied Features: Brier 0.089 SOTA — Gap Analysis & Actionable Plan

source_paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets

gap_analysis.interpretation: Our 0.22034 vs LR 0.199 = 0.021 gap achievable with tabular-only improvements. The 0.089 LSTM requires market-implied features (betting lines) as INPUT features — fundamentally different.
decomposition: Tabular-only gap (0.021): Feature engineering differences — rolling 5-game efficiency, season z-normalization, feature selection quality
Market-features gap (0.13): Betting lines encode crowd-wisdom signal unavailable in box-score stats. LSTM+dropout learns calibrated uncertainty from spread/total/implied-prob.
Neural model gap: CPU-incompatible (Rule#8). LSTM is not an island option.

paper_architecture.cnn_encoder: 3 conv-pool blocks on shot-chart spatial embeddings → PCA 20 components (92.7% variance)
feature_categories: Market-derived: implied win probability, spread, total, overround
paper_architecture.calibration: Monte Carlo dropout (50 forward passes) for Bayesian uncertainty. Season-level z-normalization.

actionable_insights.insight: Market-implied win probability as engine feature
actionable_insights.description: Add implied win prob derived from moneyline odds as a feature in engine.py Cat55 (new category: market_signals). Formula: implied_prob = 1 / (1 + decimal_odds). Our odds are in data/full-odds-2025-26.json (249 categories). This single feature may close 30-50% of the tabular gap.
actionable_insights.implementation: engine.py: add 'market_signals' category. Extract ml_home/ml_away moneyline → compute implied_prob, overround, market_consensus_winner. ~15 features.
actionable_insights.prerequisite: engine-parity-sync must complete first (VM task priority-40). Then add Cat55 to mon-ipad features/engine.py and sync.
actionable_insights.expected_brier_gain: 0.005-0.010 (estimate based on LR tabular gap 0.021, market features likely responsible for half)

actionable_insights.description: Ensure engine generates rolling-window features (5g, 10g, 20g) for OffRtg, DefRtg, NetRtg, TS%, eFG%. Season z-normalization applied across features to handle era-drift. Verify no lookahead bias in window calculation.
actionable_insights.implementation: Audit engine.py rolling features — confirm 5-game lag is implemented correctly. Add z-normalization by season.

actionable_insights.description: Normalize all features per season (mean/std from training window). Accounts for era-dependent rule changes (3-pt explosion, pace, load management). Key finding in paper: robustness 2012-2024.
actionable_insights.implementation: Add normalization step in island preprocessing or engine.py. StandardScaler per season-split.

actionable_insights.description: Monte Carlo dropout requires neural networks. Venn-Abers provides guaranteed calibration bounds for any classifier. S13 top5 already shows ET/venn_abers 62f=0.22864 (better than base ET). Apply to LR in S14 and xgboost in S18/S22.
actionable_insights.implementation: Add 'venn_abers' as calibration option in island mutation pool. Already tested in S13 top5.

actionable_insights.insight: Political alpha: Prediction market implied probs as features
actionable_insights.description: Polymarket/Kalshi market-implied probabilities for political events mirror the market-feature advantage in NBA. These encode crowd-wisdom + expert signal unavailable in polling data alone. Add via Rotation A (FEC/SEC + markets).
actionable_insights.implementation: Add Polymarket/Kalshi API scraping to political data pipeline. Features: market_implied_prob, market_volume, market_spread_vs_polling. ~10 features per event.
actionable_insights.expected_impact: Could reduce Political Brier from 0.249 toward 0.22 over 10k+ gens with fresh features

not_actionable_cpu_incompatible: LSTM (sequential model — CPU too slow for island GA)
Monte Carlo dropout at inference scale

competitive_position.our_fleet_vs_lstm_market: BEHIND by 0.131 — requires neural+market, not an island target
competitive_position.path_to_target_0_20: 0.021 gap to LR-tabular SOTA: market features + rolling efficiency + z-norm could close it. Target 0.20 within reach with tabular-only improvements.

recommended_vm_task: Add engine.py Cat55 (market_signals: implied_prob, overround, market_consensus) after engine-parity-sync completes. Test on S14 (LR already best, market feature would amplify signal). Estimated 1-2 weeks for GA to reflect improvement.
